pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit extreme geometric complexity with deeply serrated, leaf-like edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are predominantly non-convex with multiple sharp protrusions and high-frequency pixel variations along the perimeters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A dense network of light-pigmented negative space with narrow, irregular pixel thickness. Topological junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial, exhibiting a jagged, non-linear continuity that follows the serrated patch boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Discrete, light-colored linear and punctate superficial abrasions are visible within the central areas of the dark patches on the mid-flank region.
